_doc: DIMENSION 7 — the formalized Company-OS END-STATE. Each pillar is a major target subsystem; distance_to_end_state is COMPUTED as verified caps / total caps within the pillar's `domains` (or by target_crate when `crates` is set, or `manual_pct` for surfaces caps.db doesn't track like the UI). The overall completion = weighted average. DURABLE source (caps.db gitignored); reconcile-end-state.mjs re-applies. Edit to refine the vision. Seeded 2026-06-19.

pillars.name: Money Gate & Governance
pillars.description: The ONE money gate + board approval + Merkle audit + ScopePath tenancy — the safety foundation every consequential action routes through. Must be ~complete before autonomy widens.

pillars.name: ERP / Finance Core
pillars.description: The central operating truth: double-entry ledger, invoices, payments, stock valuation, assets, multi-entity consolidation. Everything else reads this.

pillars.name: Strategy Brain (CFO/game engine)
pillars.description: The game-theoretic CFO: valuation (DCF/ROIC), screening, calibration, cognition, oversight posture, capital allocation. The distinctive thesis — turns accounting into control.

pillars.name: Agent System & Autonomy
pillars.description: AI agents as governed strategic actors: runtime invoke_tool, skill-forge, multi-agent orchestration, trust-tiered autonomy (trust score -> authority ceiling). Agents never authorize money.

pillars.name: Workflow & Automation Engine
pillars.description: Durable, replayable, crash-safe business automation: workflows, schedules, sagas, the production loop. Every recurring business process rides it.

pillars.name: Observability & Analytics
pillars.description: The measurement->decision substrate: business-event capture, OLAP, metrics/TSDB, alerting/dispatch, evals, dashboards. Feeds real KPIs back into governance.

pillars.name: Revenue Engine
pillars.description: Monetization: billing, subscriptions, usage metering, marketplace take-rate, trading. Turns the platform from cost-only to revenue-capable. (Billing caps also live in erp-finance.)

pillars.name: External Arena (browser/connectors/osint)
pillars.description: Governed external execution: the browser-computer surface (armed-only, gated), the connector/execution-provider layer, OSINT market intel. The arena where companies act.

pillars.name: Security & Identity
pillars.description: Auth (OIDC prod bridge), secrets (name/presence-only + redaction), tenancy enforcement, supply-chain/secrets scanning. Reach is platform-wide.

pillars.name: Knowledge & Memory
pillars.description: RAG/hybrid search, the company knowledge graph, agent memory lifecycle. The private-data moat.

pillars.name: Support & CRM
pillars.description: The shared-inbox helpdesk + CRM (Meta-Business-Suite/Chatwoot parity). Largely built; consolidation into chronica-helpdesk pending.

pillars.name: Infra & Company Instantiation
pillars.description: Deploy/runtime/k8s + the template->running-company instantiation pipeline. Provisions and runs company stacks.

pillars.name: Media & Creative
pillars.description: Programmatic video/image content generation pipelines for content-producing companies.

pillars.name: Feed / Product Surface
pillars.description: The X-like operational social feed — the operating console (posts = approvals/decisions/runs/erp/strategy, inline). UI is TS (not in caps.db); tracked by the feed-first redesign. ~35% (core feed + approve/comments/messenger built; agent-profile/strategy-live/command-palette pending).
